# video

Record, edit and generate video — reels, demos and explainers — with a QA agent before anything goes out.

Request: $ARGUMENTS — if it names a repo (kun · hogwarts), add `--repo <repo>` to every station call below.

1. **No request** — run `node ~/kun/.claude/scripts/station.mjs board --dept video [--repo <repo>] --json` and show its up-to-three options (`label_en` / `label_ar`, `why`). The person taps one or types text.
2. **A request** — run `node ~/kun/.claude/scripts/station.mjs match "<text>" --dept video [--repo <repo>] --json`.
   - It names a formula (`id`): run `node ~/kun/.claude/scripts/station.mjs fill <id> --dept video [--repo <repo>] --json`, show the filled `prompt`, ask for anything in `missing`, then hand it to the `video` agent on the `route` the fill returns.
   - `id` is null: no formula fits. Hand the request to the `video` agent in the department's frame (`departments/video/pack.json` → `formula.en`: Task · Context · References · Constraints · Deliverable).
3. The agent plans and judges; building goes to cheaper lanes with a written brief. It stops at every human gate and never approves.

Tools of the department: the `video` agent · `/produce` · `/edit` · `/record` · `/shoot` · `/blender` · `/higgs` · the `media-qa` agent.
